purpose: Compose translation mounts and center-to-center distance joints around one shared donor-core integration step so callers can use both bounded constraint families without accidentally advancing physics time twice.

properties.options: bounded family pass counts plus bounded per-family position/velocity iteration counts

relationships.basis: The imported donor source remains unchanged; the composer performs one donor-core integration between additive pre- and post-constraint stages.

limitations: supports only the existing translation-mount and center-to-center distance-joint families
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
no angular inertia or rotating local anchors
no hinge, slider, weld, motor or gear constraints
connected constrained bodies can still collide unless caller filters suppress that pair
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: translation mounts and distance joints share one donor-core integration per composed step
post-core mixed-family stabilization repairs gravity-induced drift for independent constraints
family passes and nested solver iterations remain bounded
core-stage contact evidence remains separately inspectable

truth.basis: The composer names its fixed ordering bias, bounded convergence limits and core-stage contact evidence boundary rather than presenting composition as a complete rigid-body solver.

agency.basis: Callers explicitly choose constraint data and bounded pass/iteration budgets while the default order remains inspectable and deterministic.

continuity.basis: The donor core and both existing constraint capabilities are reused without replacement; this is an additive orchestration layer.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The capability solves the concrete double-integration composition gap before adding new joint families or claiming a generalized constraint engine.
